question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

A real warrior does not________ (surrender) to his enemies.
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: expose
smile
cooperate
yield
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: yield

yield - yield

Explanation:
The word "surrender" means to give up or submit, and "yield" is the closest synonym among the given options as it also means to give in or concede.
"सरेंडर" का अर्थ है हार मान लेना या समर्पण करना, और "yield" दिए गए विकल्पों में सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी झुक जाना या स्वीकार करना है।

Other synonyms Words:
submit, capitulate, relent, succumb, concede

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

surrender – समर्पण करना – To give up or hand over.
Example: "The soldiers had to surrender after running out of supplies."

expose – उजागर करना – To reveal or make something visible.
Example: "The journalist decided to expose the corruption scandal."

smile – मुस्कुराना – To form a pleased or friendly expression with the mouth.
Example: "She gave a warm smile to the guest."

cooperate – सहयोग करना – To work together towards a common goal.
Example: "The two companies agreed to cooperate on the project."

yield – झुक जाना / समर्पण करना – To give way under pressure or to surrender.
Example: "A real warrior does not yield to his enemies."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "yield" is the best synonym for "surrender" because both imply giving up or submitting under pressure, making it the most appropriate choice for the sentence.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Surreptitious
(Head Constable Ministerial)
options: Forthright
Omnipresent
Overt
Clandestine
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Clandestine

Surreptitious - Clandestine

Explanation:
"Surreptitious" means done secretly to avoid being noticed, and "Clandestine" also refers to something kept secret or done covertly.
(सुर्रेप्टिशस का अर्थ है गुप्त रूप से किया गया, और क्लैंडेस्टाइन भी गुप्त या छुपकर किए गए कार्य को दर्शाता है।)

Other synonyms Words:
Secretive, Covert, Stealthy, Furtive, Undercover

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Surreptitious – गुप्त – (Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of)
Example: "He made a surreptitious entry into the building."

Forthright – स्पष्टवादी – (Direct and outspoken; straightforward)
Example: "She was forthright in her criticism of the plan."

Omnipresent – सर्वव्यापी – (Present everywhere at the same time)
Example: "Technology has become omnipresent in modern life."

Overt – प्रकट – (Done or shown openly; not secret or hidden)
Example: "His overt dislike for the idea was evident."

Clandestine – गुप्त – (Kept secret or done secretly, especially because illicit)
Example: "They held a clandestine meeting to discuss the illegal operation."

Conclusion:
"Clandestine" is the best synonym for "Surreptitious" as both imply secrecy and concealment, unlike the other options which either mean openness (Forthright, Overt) or universality (Omnipresent).

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Survey
(CHSL Exam 2023 Tier I)
options: Slothful
Apathy
Scrutinise
Disregard
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Scrutinise

Survey - Scrutinise

Explanation:
"Scrutinise" means to examine or inspect something closely, which aligns with the meaning of "survey" as a detailed examination.
"Scrutinise" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को बारीकी से जाँचना, जो "survey" के अर्थ के अनुरूप है।

Examine, Inspect, Analyse, Study, Assess

Example: "The team conducted a survey to gather public opinion."

Slothful – आलसी – Lazy or inactive.
Example: "His slothful attitude affected his productivity."

Apathy – उदासीनता – Lack of interest or concern.
Example: "Her apathy towards social issues was concerning."

Disregard – उपेक्षा – Ignore or pay no attention to.
Example: "He chose to disregard the warning signs."

Scrutinise – जाँचना – Examine closely and thoroughly.
Example: "The detective scrutinised the evidence for clues."

Conclusion:
"Scrutinise" is the best synonym for "survey" as both involve careful examination. The other options (Slothful, Apathy, Disregard) do not match the meaning of "survey."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Susceptible
(SICPO Paper II 2022)
options: Critical
Impressionable
Sceptical
Immune
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Impressionable

Susceptible - Impressionable

Explanation:
"Susceptible" means easily influenced or affected by something, and "Impressionable" also refers to someone who is easily influenced, especially because they are young or lack experience.
"Susceptible" का अर्थ है आसानी से प्रभावित होने वाला, और "Impressionable" भी किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो आसानी से प्रभावित हो जाता है, खासकर क्योंकि वह युवा या अनुभवहीन है।

Other synonyms Words:
Vulnerable, Sensitive, Receptive, Gullible, Pliable

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Susceptible – प्रभावित होने वाला – Likely to be influenced or harmed by something.
Example: "Children are more susceptible to peer pressure."

Critical – आलोचनात्मक – Expressing adverse or disapproving comments.
Example: "She was critical of his careless attitude."

Sceptical – संशयशील – Doubtful or not easily convinced.
Example: "He was sceptical about the new policy."

Immune – प्रतिरक्षित – Protected against a particular disease or influence.
Example: "Vaccination makes the body immune to certain diseases."

Impressionable – आसानी से प्रभावित होने वाला – Easily influenced because of a lack of critical thinking.
Example: "Teenagers are often impressionable and may follow trends blindly."

Conclusion:
"Impressionable" is the best synonym for "Susceptible" because both words describe someone who is easily influenced or affected by external factors. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

changed
ended
solution:

The word "suspended" in this context means temporarily stopped or delayed. "Postponed" is the correct synonym as it also means to delay an event to a later time.
हिंदी अर्थ: "Suspended" का अर्थ है अस्थायी रूप से रोक देना या स्थगित करना। "Postponed" सही पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी कार्यक्रम को बाद के समय के लिए टालना है।

delayed, deferred, adjourned, held off, put off

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Suspended – स्थगित – To temporarily stop or delay something.
Example: "His membership was suspended due to misconduct."

continued – जारी रखा – To keep going without interruption.
Example: "Despite the rain, the match continued."

changed – बदला – To make or become different.
Example: "She changed her dress before the party."

ended – समाप्त – To bring something to a conclusion.
Example: "The meeting ended at 5 PM."

postponed – स्थगित – To delay an event to a later time.
Example: "The match was postponed due to bad weather."

Conclusion:
"Postponed" is the best synonym for "suspended" in this context because both imply a temporary delay. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word given below.

Suspicious
(212 Combine Competitive Exam Group A and B)
options: Sure
Certain
Doubtful
Undeniable
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Doubtful

Suspicious - Doubtful

Explanation:
The word "suspicious" means having or showing distrust or doubt. "Doubtful" is the correct synonym as it also conveys a sense of uncertainty or lack of trust.
संदिग्ध का अर्थ है संदेह या अविश्वास होना। "Doubtful" सही समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह भी अनिश्चितता या अविश्वास की भावना व्यक्त करता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Distrustful, Wary, Skeptical, Mistrustful, Hesitant

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Suspicious – संदिग्ध – Having or showing cautious distrust.
Example: "She gave him a suspicious look when he entered the room late."

Sure – निश्चित – Confident in one's belief.
Example: "I am sure that he will come on time."

Certain – यक़ीनन – Known for sure; established beyond doubt.
Example: "It is certain that the sun will rise tomorrow."

Undeniable – निर्विवाद – Unable to be denied or disputed.
Example: "His talent is undeniable."

Doubtful – संदिग्ध – Feeling uncertain about something.
Example: "He was doubtful about the success of the plan."

Conclusion:
"Doubtful" is the best synonym for "suspicious" because both words express a sense of uncertainty or distrust, unlike the other options which convey confidence or certainty.

question:

Sustain
(ASI(Steno))
options: Uphold
Dominate
Instill
Insert
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Uphold

[Word] - Sustain

Explanation:
The word "sustain" means to support, maintain, or uphold something over time. "Uphold" is the best synonym as it also means to maintain or support a principle, law, or tradition.
(शब्द "sustain" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को समय के साथ सहारा देना, बनाए रखना या मजबूती से थामे रखना। "Uphold" सबसे उपयुक्त पर्याय है क्योंकि यह भी किसी सिद्धांत, कानून या परंपरा को बनाए रखने का भाव देता है।)

Other synonyms Words:
Maintain, Support, Preserve, Bear, Endure

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Sustain – बनाए रखना – To support, maintain, or keep something going.
Example: "The government must sustain economic growth."

Dominate – हावी होना – To have control or power over something.
Example: "The team dominated the match from the beginning."

Instill – मन में बैठाना – To gradually introduce an idea or feeling into someone's mind.
Example: "Parents should instill good values in their children."

Insert – डालना – To put something inside something else.
Example: "Please insert the key into the lock."

Uphold – बनाए रखना / समर्थन करना – To maintain or support in the face of opposition.
Example: "The court upheld the decision of the lower judiciary."

Conclusion:
"Uphold" is the best synonym for "sustain" because both words imply maintaining or supporting something firmly over time, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:

solution:

tantalise - Provoke

The word "tantalise" means to tease or torment someone with something they desire but cannot have, which is similar to "provoke" as it means to stimulate or incite a reaction.
"tantalise" का अर्थ है किसी को उसकी इच्छा से छेड़ना या परेशान करना, जो "provoke" (उकसाना) के समान है, क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी प्रतिक्रिया को उत्तेजित करना है।

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

tantalise – ललचाना – (to tease or torment by offering something desirable but keeping it out of reach)
Example: "The smell of freshly baked cookies tantalised the hungry children."

Direct – निर्देशित करना – (to guide or instruct someone)
Example: "The teacher directed the students to complete their assignments."

Misguide – गुमराह करना – (to lead someone in the wrong direction)
Example: "False advertisements can misguide consumers."

Pacify – शांत करना – (to calm someone down)
Example: "The mother pacified her crying baby with a lullaby."

Provoke – उकसाना – (to stimulate or incite a reaction)
Example: "His rude remarks provoked an angry response."

Conclusion:
"Provoke" is the best synonym for "tantalise" because both words involve stimulating a reaction, whether it's desire or irritation. The other options do not convey the teasing or tormenting aspect of "tantalise."

question:

options: Ruthlessness
Spitefulness
Severity
Kindness
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Kindness

Tenderness - Kindness

Explanation:
Tenderness refers to a gentle, caring, and affectionate attitude, which aligns closely with kindness. Kindness involves being considerate and compassionate towards others.
स्नेहशीलता एक कोमल, देखभाल करने वाला और स्नेहपूर्ण व्यवहार है, जो दयालुता के साथ मेल खाता है। दयालुता में दूसरों के प्रति विचारशील और करुणामय होना शामिल है।

Tenderness – स्नेहशीलता – A gentle, caring, or affectionate feeling
Example: "She spoke to the child with great tenderness."

Ruthlessness – निर्दयता – Lack of pity or compassion
Example: "His ruthlessness in business made him many enemies."

Spitefulness – द्वेषपूर्णता – A desire to hurt or annoy someone
Example: "Her spitefulness made the workplace toxic."

Example: "The severity of the punishment shocked everyone."

Kindness – दयालुता – The quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate
Example: "His kindness towards strangers was well-known."

Conclusion:
"Kindness" is the best synonym for "tenderness" as both words convey warmth, care, and compassion, unlike the other options which represent negative traits.
